items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 31:1
items.html: Malchut of the Guf [body], from which the limitation and the rejection of the light in actuality begin, is called “Tabur.” (Part 4, Chapter 1, Item 8)
